summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of share awards under its Agency Long Term Incentive Plan. On 3 June 2026, awards covering 203,181 new ordinary shares were granted to non-employees at nil purchase price, with a closing price of HK$112 per share on grant date. The awards vest on 25 March 2029 with no performance conditions but include a clawback mechanism for material restatements, regulatory breaches, or misconduct. This is a routine equity grant disclosure, not a special situation.
